reasoning_traces.think:
The core operators form a layered system where selective publishing gates information flow, score bake-off blends confidence and edge into a coherent truth signal, and historical projection provides temporal context for resolution. Independent model probabilities act as a kernel that prices into rankings, ensuring alignment with underlying game dynamics. The isotonic calibration ensures that these rankings remain reliable even under noisy inputs. Failure modes include overfitting due to low-resolution groups, misalignment between confidence and true probability, and lack of sufficient filtered settles to support valid projections. Dualities emerge in how confidence and edge interact—when one is high, the other may be low, leading to balanced blending. The system avoids Platt scaling and lowering floors, which would introduce bias or instability.
